$comment: Runtime packages a workspace may depend on, each with the reason (docs/plan.md, Technologie). The agent runs on every managed server, the Zentrale holds every customer: few packages, each one read. `bun run lint` fails on a dependency missing here or used by a workspace not listed for it. Workspace packages (@steuerzentrale/*) need no entry. A new entry comes in the pull request that needs it. "major" pins the major version where npm's latest is the wrong line (Solid 1 for TanStack); "forbidden" lists packages that may appear nowhere, dev dependencies included.

zod.reason: Zod 4: every value that crosses a boundary (manifest, messages between Zentrale and agent, API) is parsed against a schema; no dependencies of its own

yaml.reason: Manifests are YAML (docs/plan.md, Manifest); a parser without dependencies of its own

@noble/curves.reason: Ed25519 to verify minisign signatures of manifests and agent binaries; audited, pure TypeScript

@noble/hashes.reason: BLAKE2b, the prehash of minisign signatures; audited, pure TypeScript

hono.reason: HTTP and WebSocket server of the Zentrale (docs/plan.md, Technologie, as in Kennwort and Soll)

drizzle-orm.reason: SQLite with migrations in the binary (docs/plan.md, Technologie)

better-auth.reason: Accounts, organizations (one per operator), passkeys and TOTP (docs/plan.md, Anmeldung)

@better-auth/passkey.reason: Passkeys for Better Auth (docs/plan.md, Anmeldung), as in Kennwort and Soll

@peculiar/x509.reason: The Zentrale issues and checks the X.509 client certificates of the agents (docs/plan.md, TLS und Zertifikate); Bun cannot issue certificates. Only in the Zentrale, never on a managed server. Major 1, the line @simplewebauthn/server (passkeys) uses: two lines in one binary share tsyringe's container, and the later one's algorithms break the other's ASN.1 (Z-302)

solid-js.reason: Solid 2, the UI of the Zentrale, as in Kennwort and Soll

@solidjs/web.reason: Solid 2's DOM renderer, split out of solid-js in 2.0

lucide.reason: Icon data for the Icon component of packages/ui (lucide-solid carries only Solid 1), as in Soll

@fontsource-variable/geist.reason: Geist shipped with the UI instead of loaded from Google Fonts (DESIGN.md), as in packages/ui of Kennwort

@fontsource-variable/geist-mono.reason: Geist Mono for versions, digests and commands, shipped with the UI like Geist (DESIGN.md)

uqr.reason: The QR code with which an authenticator app takes the TOTP secret (docs/plan.md, Anmeldung): a dependency-free TypeScript port of Nayuki's reference QR encoder (MIT), generation only, as in Kennwort; the page draws the SVG itself

@tanstack/solid-router.reason: Routing of the SPA with file-based, typed routes, as in Soll; 2.x is the line built for Solid 2 (1.x needs Solid 1; transitive Solid-1 packages listed in docs/solid-2.0/README.md)

@tanstack/solid-query.reason: Server data in the SPA (cache, refetch, mutations); 6.x is the line built for Solid 2 (5.x needs Solid 1)

forbidden.lucide-solid: carries only Solid 1; use lucide with the Icon component of packages/ui
forbidden.vite-plugin-solid: the Solid 1 Vite plugin; Solid 2 uses @solidjs/vite-plugin
forbidden.@solidjs/router: a second router beside @tanstack/solid-router, which docs/plan.md decides for the SPA
